The department shall adopt rules 21 pursuant to chapter 17A which shall include but not be limited 22 to all of the following: 23 EXPLANATION 24 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 25 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 26 This bill relates to matters under the purview of the 27 department of inspections, appeals, and licensing. The bill is 28 organized in divisions. 29 DIVISION I —— GAMBLING. The bill eliminates a 30 $30,000-per-year total cap on reimbursements that the state 31 racing and gaming commission (commission) may pay to all 32 commissioners for expenses incurred in the performance of the 33 commissioners’ duties. The bill grants the commission explicit 34 authority to issue cease and desist orders and seek injunctive 35 -3- LSB 5523DP (4) 91 ss/ns 3/ 4 S.F. _____ H.F. _____ relief against persons who offer gambling services in the state 1 without an appropriate license or authorization. 2 Under current law, a person commits a class “D” felony 3 and is barred for life from excursion gambling boats and 4 gambling structures under the jurisdiction of the commission 5 for committing certain acts listed in Code section 99F.15(4). 6 The bill expands the lifetime ban to include sports wagering 7 and advance deposit sports wagering. The bill also imposes a 8 lifetime ban from sports wagering and advance deposit sports 9 wagering on a person who is convicted twice of unlawful 10 betting. 11 DIVISION II —— STATE BUILDING CODE. The bill requires the 12 state building code commissioner to consult with the department 13 of homeland security and emergency management, instead of 14 the department of public defense, in adopting rules relating 15 to safe rooms and storm shelters. The bill also requires 16 fees collected by the state building code commissioner to be 17 deposited in the licensing and regulation fund instead of the 18 general fund of the state. 19 DIVISION III —— RESIDENTIAL CARE FACILITIES. The bill 20 allows a residential care facility that is a pediatric 21 palliative care center to serve as few as zero individuals. 22 Under current law, an entity must serve at least three 23 individuals to be defined as a residential care facility. 24 -4- LSB 5523DP (4) 91 ss/ns 4/ 4
